Now I can join the `superhero.csv` with the unnested `gender.json` data, filter for female superheroes, and calculate the average `weight_kg`. I will also filter out `weight_kg = 0` as it likely represents missing or invalid data.

action_input.sql:
SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg) AS average_female_weight
FROM 'csv/superhero.csv' AS s
JOIN (SELECT r.id AS gender_id, r.gender FROM (SELECT unnest(records) AS r FROM read_json_auto('json/gender.json')) t) AS g
ON s.gender_id = g.gender_id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female' AND s.weight_kg > 0;
